file.notfound:
File not found: {path}
This does NOT mean the project is missing — the path may be wrong. Run list_dir on the working directory first; create files only after confirming what exists.
file.edit_args_invalid: edit_file requires string "old" and "new" arguments. Received: old={oldType}, new={newType}.
file.protected_path_ask: Protected path "{path}" (matches {pattern}). Do NOT modify it. Ask the user for explicit confirmation before proceeding and wait for their answer — do not retry around this.
file.notfound_resolved:
File not found: {path} (resolved to {resolved})
The path was joined onto the working directory because it does not exist as given. Run list_dir to find the correct path.
file.read_truncated: [Truncated: {remaining} more lines. Use read_file with offset={next} to continue]
error.empty_response: Model returned an empty response after retries
error.audit_failed: Task could not be verified as complete: {summary}
error.retry_loop_stopped: Stopped after {count} consecutive failed tool batches — the agent kept retrying a failing action instead of finishing
error.readonly_loop_stopped: Stopped after {count} repeated identical tool calls — the agent kept issuing the same action instead of answering
error.grep_no_engine: grep engine "{engine}" is unavailable: no such binary in PATH. Set tools.grepEngine=auto or js, or use read_file/list_dir.
error.llm_429: Rate limit exceeded (HTTP 429) for {model} on {baseUrl}. The provider is throttling requests — free models are especially strict. Get an API key or switch to a paid/faster model: {baseUrl}
error.llm_stream_idle: LLM stream stalled — no data for {timeout}ms. If the provider buffers streaming (e.g. LM Studio) or generates very long tool calls, raise "retry.noDataTimeoutMs" in ~/.mma/config.json (restart required)
error.llm_stream_idle_toolcall: LLM stream stalled after a tool_call started — no data for {timeout}ms. The provider most likely buffers SSE instead of streaming tool-call argument deltas (seen with LM Studio). Raise "retry.noDataTimeoutMs" in ~/.mma/config.json (restart required)
error.llm_truncated: Response hit the completion token limit ({tokens}) and was cut off before any content arrived. Split the task into smaller outputs or raise "maxCompletionTokens" in the config
error.llm_truncated_toolcall: Response hit the completion token limit ({tokens}) in the middle of a tool_call — its arguments were cut off. Write the file in smaller chunks (several write_file/edit_file calls) or raise "maxCompletionTokens" in the config
error.llm_output_truncated: The response hit the completion token limit ({tokens}) and was cut off — this answer is incomplete. Raise "maxCompletionTokens" in the config to allow longer replies
error.context_log_init: Context log is enabled but could not be initialized: {error}. No context diff will be written.

env.runtime_old: Runtime version {version} is below the required engines {engine}.
env.playwright_missing: Playwright package is not installed — the browser tool will fail. Install with: bun add playwright
env.playwright_browsers_missing: Playwright browsers not downloaded ({dir}). The browser tool will fail. Install with: bunx playwright install chromium
env.crash_stderr: MMA crashed ({type}): {message} — crash report written to ~/.mma/logs/crash.jsonl
env.model_autoload_failed: Model auto-load failed: {error}. Continuing with manual load.
env.indexed: Indexed {files} file(s) for the project map

proc.promoted_hint: Command still running after {ms} ms — moved to the background
proc.manage_hint: Check output: process_log id={id}. Wait for completion: process_wait id={id}. Stop it: process_kill id={id}. List all: process_list.
proc.missing_id: Provide the process id: process_kill id=proc_xxx (the id is returned by bash when a command goes to the background, or by process_list).
proc.missing_id_list: No background processes are currently running.
proc.wait_exited: Process {id} {status} after {ms} ms with exit code {code}.
proc.wait_hint: Wait again: process_wait id={id}. Check output: process_log id={id}. Stop it: process_kill id={id}.
plan.no_steps: No plan steps specified. Provide concrete steps with files and commands.
plan.coverage_blocked: Plan does not cover files required by the task: {missing}. Add steps naming these files (exact paths) with checks, then call plan create again.
plan.checks_required: Each step needs a verification contract: pass checks aligned 1:1 with steps — one per step: "file-exists:<path>" (auto-verified on done), "command:<cmd>" (run it before done), or "manual:<what to check by eye>" (UI/visual work only).
plan.checks_not_array: checks must be an array of check strings, aligned 1:1 with steps
plan.checks_mismatch: checks must align 1:1 with steps: got {actual} checks for {expected} steps. Example: steps ["Create src/a.ts"] + checks ["file-exists:src/a.ts"]. Omit checks to let each step self-certify.
plan.checks_invalid: Invalid check(s): {kinds}. Each check must start with "file-exists:", "command:", or "manual:".
plan.check_failed: Cannot mark step {step} done: its check failed — {check}. Run the check first (create the file / run the command), then mark done.
plan.check_self_certified: check self-certified: {check} — confirmed run before done.
plan.completed_archived: Plan {id} is complete ({done}/{total} steps) — archived. You may create a new plan for new work (plan create), or reply with your final answer.
plan.no_active_with_last: No active plan. Last completed: {id} "{title}" ({done}/{total} steps). Continue with a new plan (action=create) or finish your answer.
plan.step_required: Provide the step number: plan_step step=N status=done|failed|skipped.
plan.step_already_done: Step {step} is already done — nothing to do. Plan progress:
plan.order_blocked: Cannot mark step {step} done: step {first} ("{desc}") is not finished yet. Complete earlier steps first, or mark step {first} status=skipped if it is not needed.
plan.deliverables_missing: Cannot mark step {step} done: the files it names do not exist yet: {files}. Create these files first (or mark the step status=skipped if they are not actually needed).
plan.kinds_mismatch: kinds array length must match steps
plan.kinds_not_array: kinds must be an array of "create" or "delete"
plan.deliverables_remain: Cannot mark step {step} done: the files it names still exist: {files}. This step is kind=delete — delete these files first (or set status=skipped if they should stay).
plan.switch_no_id: Provide a plan id to switch to
plan.replanned: Plan re-planned: {kept} completed steps kept, {steps} new steps added
plan.active_in_progress: Cannot create a new plan: active plan {id} already has progress ({done}/{total} done, current: step {current}). Resume it — use "plan show" to view, then continue working. To replace it, call "plan abort" first, then "plan create" again.
plan.id_ignored: note: plan ids are auto-generated; use "plan switch" to activate an existing plan by id.
plan.existing_fresh: note: the previous active plan had no progress and was preserved as a draft.
plan.already_active: Plan {id} is already active — nothing to switch.
plan.already_archived: Plan {id} is already archived — nothing to abort.
plan.delete_no_id: Provide a plan id to delete (plan delete id=plan_xxx).
plan.purged: Deleted {count} plan(s). Plan storage is empty.
plan.no_deliverables: note: step {step} names no files — verify the result in a task-appropriate way before your final answer (for code: build/tests/lint; for research/advice tasks: re-check the answer, do NOT create files just to have deliverables).
plan.bulk_update_rejected: Bulk steps[] rewrite via action=update is not supported: it would discard all step statuses. Use "re-plan" (keeps completed steps, replaces the rest) or mark steps individually: plan_step step=N status=done|failed|skipped.
plan.readonly: Plan {id} is {status} (read-only) — it cannot be updated. Use "plan switch" to activate it, or create a new plan for new work.
exec.plan_nudge: You made {count} file-changing tool call(s) without a plan. For tasks that create or modify files, or span multiple steps, create a plan first (plan create) with concrete steps (exact filenames, commands, deliverables), then continue.
exec.plan_summary_complete: [{id}] "{title}" {done}/{total} done — plan complete. You may create a new plan for new work (plan create), or reply with your final answer.
exec.plan_summary_continue: [{id}] "{title}" {done}/{total} done, current: step {current} — continue it (plan show / re-plan), do NOT create a new plan
exec.test_fail_summary: {framework} reported {failed} FAILING test(s) ({passed} passing). Do NOT mark the current step as done — fix the failing tests (read the failure output, correct the code) and re-run them until all pass.
exec.test_pass_summary: {framework}: all {passed} test(s) passed for "{cmd}". You may mark the current step as done via plan_step step=N status=done.
exec.skills_hint: If relevant skills are available, consider loading one with load_skill for expert guidance.
todo.no_items: No todo items specified — provide items to mark done
todo.subtask_not_found: No matching sub-task(s) found for: {items}. Use ids from todo list (todo done ids=[...]) for reliable matching.
todo.subtask_id_not_found: No sub-task(s) with id(s): {ids}. Check ids with todo list.
verify.file_still_exists: File should be deleted but still exists: {path}
verify.no_files: Step {step} has no named files to verify — run a real check instead (bash: bun run build / bun test / lsp_check) and confirm the result.
verify.typecheck_skipped_no_tsconfig: No tsconfig.json found — skipping type check
verify.typecheck_skipped_no_tsc: tsc not installed — skipping type check
verify.tests_skipped_no_script: No test script defined — skipping tests

exec.stuck: No progress on step {stepId} ({description}) for {iterations} iterations.
exec.stuck_recovery: Step {stepId} — "{description}" — has had no progress for {iterations} iterations. Try a different approach: review what this step needs, check if dependencies are installed, or create files directly via write_file instead of shell commands. After completing the step call plan_step step={stepId} status=done.
exec.tool_errors: Tool {tool} failed {count} times. Consider using a different tool.
exec.tool_errors_recovery: Tool {tool} has failed {count} times in a row. Try an alternative: create files directly via write_file, use a different command, or if nothing works — skip this step via plan_step step=N status=skipped with a note explaining why.
exec.repetitive_tool: Called {tool} {count} times with identical arguments and result. Try a different approach — create files directly, change arguments, or check process status via process_log.
exec.repetitive_process_log_hint: You are polling a background process — call process_wait once instead of polling process_log.
exec.consecutive_failures_recovery: {count} consecutive tool failures. Create files directly via write_file instead of terminal commands. Check that dependencies are installed (npm install). Do not run build/tests until all files are created.
exec.bash_flailing_recovery: bash failed in {fails} of the last {window} attempts. Stop using shell commands for file operations on this machine — they do not work. Use the dedicated tools instead: read_file (the header shows line counts), write_file, edit_file, file_info (file size), glob/grep for search
exec.bash_flailing: bash failed in {fails} of the last {window} attempts.
exec.honest_stop: STOP retrying. {count} consecutive tool batches failed or were blocked with no successful call in between — more variants of the same action will not help. Do NOT try another command, flag, or workaround for this. Write your final text answer NOW: state plainly what was done, what could NOT be done or verified, and why. Do NOT paste output you did not actually receive from a tool.
exec.readonly_directive: You have repeated the same tool call {count} times with no new result. Stop repeating: either WRITE your final answer with what you already have, or do something genuinely different.
exec.finalize_no_tools: Tools are now disabled. Write your final answer from what you have already gathered. Do not request tools or ask to continue; state plainly what you found and, if the task is incomplete, what remains unverified.
exec.read_only_loop: No write/exec for {count} tool calls — the agent is only reading/exploring.
exec.read_only_loop_recovery: {count} consecutive read-only tool calls (read_file/glob/grep/browser) with no writes. STOP exploring and make the edit the task requires: read the file, then call write_file or edit_file. If you cannot finish the task, ask the user instead of re-reading the same files.
exec.plan_warning: Current plan step {step} is "{description}", but {tool} is being called for files outside this step. Complete the current step first, then call plan_step step={step} status=done before moving to the next step.
exec.plan_blocked: {max} consecutive calls outside the current step. Finish step {step} before proceeding — other steps should wait until this one is complete.
exec.off_track: Step {stepId} — "{description}" — but you are using {tool} on a different path. Return to the current step.
exec.step_gate_deps: [⚠ Step {step} "{description}": dependencies are not installed. First run the install command (npm install, pip install, etc.). Verify the lock file or dependency directory exists. If this step is NOT actually needed (no external dependencies), skip it: plan_step step={step} status=skipped note="deps not needed".]
exec.step_gate_deps_force: [⚠ Step {step}: dependencies still not installed (no lock file) — 2nd warning. If this step is NOT needed, IMMEDIATELY call: plan_step step={step} status=skipped note="deps not needed". If it IS needed, run the install command right now. Do NOT make other tool calls before updating the plan.]
exec.step_gate_empty: [⚠ Step {step}: files exist but appear empty: {files}. Add real code to these files before advancing to the next step.]
exec.step_gate_ok: [✓] Step {step} completed and verified. MOVING to step {nextStep}: "{nextDesc}". Work ONLY on this step.
exec.step_gate_last: [✓] Step {step} completed — that was the final step. Verify everything together and provide the final answer.]
exec.step_gate_manual: [⚠ Step {step}: its deliverables look present, but auto-advance is off. If the step is truly done, mark it yourself: plan_step step={step} status=done. If not, continue working on it.]
exec.audit_pass: [✓] Task complete: {done}/{total} steps done, {files} files verified
exec.audit_pending: [✗] Task incomplete: {done}/{total} steps done — remaining steps are not marked done
exec.audit_fail: [✗] Task incomplete: {done}/{total} steps done, {files} files missing
exec.audit_leftovers: [✗] Task incomplete: {done}/{total} steps done, {files} files from delete-steps still exist

exec.audit_incomplete: ❗ Final audit incomplete: {summary}. Task is NOT finished. Remaining steps: {steps}. Resolve them - pick ONE path: (a) if the step's deliverable already exists on disk, mark it done (plan_step step=N status=done); (b) if the step is no longer needed, mark it skipped; (c) if the plan drifted from reality (wrong file names, changed approach), re-plan to align it. Do NOT retry plan_step repeatedly without changing anything.
exec.mass_edit_warning: ⚠️ Plan affects {count} files — review the full list before proceeding.
exec.escalation: ⚠️ Agent stuck on step {stepId} ({description}). Escalating to user — please provide guidance.
exec.escalation_directive: You have been stuck for several attempts. Stop repeating the same action and pick ONE of these: (1) switch to a fundamentally different approach, (2) search the exact error text with web_search (or the error-search tool), (3) ask the user a short clarifying question, or (4) if the step cannot be completed, use plan_step step=<n> status=skipped with a note (or re-plan). Explain your choice briefly.
exec.test_churn_nudge: You have edited the test/spec file "{file}" several times in a row without changing any production code. If the tests fail, fix the PRODUCTION code under test (not the test) unless the test itself is genuinely wrong — and if so, explain why. If you intended test-first, now write the implementation.
exec.script_workaround_nudge: A security restriction already blocked one of your commands. Writing a shell script (.bat/.cmd/.sh/.ps1) to run it another way does NOT lift the restriction and usually just fails. Instead: use write_file for file output, run one plain command per call, pass "workdir" instead of "cd", or ask the user.
exec.file_rewrite_warning: ⚠️ File {file} has been rewritten {count} times. Consider a different approach — the current fix strategy is not working.
exec.forbidden_cmd: STOP using "{cmd}" via the bash tool — it is not a native Windows cmd.exe command and has failed repeatedly this session. Use the dedicated tool instead: grep → the grep tool, ls/dir → list_dir, find → glob, rm → delete_file, sed → edit_file, touch → write_file, which → `where`, cp/mv → move_file, diff → read_file. Do NOT call bash for this purpose again.
exec.error_search_no_query: Error output is not meaningful — skipping the web search.
exec.npm_exec_hint: "could not determine executable to run" — no "bin" for that package/script. Use "npm run <script>" (script must exist in package.json) or "bunx <pkg>" for a package that declares a bin.
exec.interactive_hint: the command needed interactive input but the shell has no TTY (prompt aborted). Re-run it non-interactively — pass every required flag/argument (e.g. `bun create vite <name> --template react-ts` instead of a bare interactive scaffold).
exec.hidden_tool_hint: "{tool}" is not a shell command — it is an MMA tool that is currently hidden. Call the enable_tools tool with tags ["shell"] to unlock it; it becomes available on the next iteration.
exec.tool_as_command_hint: "{tool}" is an MMA tool, not a shell command. Call it as a tool (function call), not through bash.
exec.task_reminder: Task: {task}. Continue making progress — do not repeat failed actions.

config.desc.provider.fallback: Fall back to the next provider entry when the active one fails.

config.desc.indexer.mapTokenBudget: Token budget for the PageRank-ranked file list in the project map (200-20000).

config.desc.session.autoName: Derive a session name from the first message (LLM-refined).
config.desc.sessionIsolation.enabled: Master switch for per-session isolation (plugins, temp files).
config.desc.sessionIsolation.isolatePlug: Give each session its own plugin sandbox.
config.desc.sessionIsolation.isolateTemp: Give each session its own temp-file directory.
config.desc.ui.spinner: Animate a progress spinner while tools run.
config.desc.ui.activityRail: Indicator above the input line while the agent works.
config.desc.ui.showContextStats: Show context usage stats after each turn.
config.desc.ui.showCompaction: Notify in chat when history compaction runs.
config.desc.ui.fontSize: Web chat font size (web only, the terminal is unaffected).
config.desc.retry.maxRetries: Max retries for failed LLM requests (0-10).
config.desc.retry.baseDelay: Base backoff delay between retries in ms (0-60000).
config.desc.retry.maxDelay: Backoff delay cap between retries in ms (0-300000).
config.desc.retry.maxStreamRetries: Max retries for stalled or interrupted streams (0-10).
config.desc.retry.noDataTimeoutMs: Give up on a stream silent for this long, in ms (1000-600000).
config.desc.pricing.enabled: Track token usage and estimated cost per session.
config.desc.updater.enabled: Master switch for background update checks.
config.desc.updater.intervalMs: Minimum time between update checks, in ms (0-86400000).
config.desc.skills.budget: Share of the system budget reserved for skill definitions (0.05-0.9).
config.desc.plugins.disabled: Names of plugins to skip. Their hooks stop firing right away, without a restart — but the plugin code itself was already loaded, so this is a switch, not a sandbox.
config.desc.plugins.maxDrafts: How many agent-written capability drafts to keep per project (.mma/plugins/drafts/). Older ones are evicted first. Drafts stay inert until the user approves them.
config.desc.hallucination.judge.enabled: Score answer confidence and flag likely hallucinations.
config.desc.subagent.resultMode: How subagent results return: inline text or via file.
config.desc.subagent.maxSummaryChars: Max chars kept from a subagent summary (100-50000).
config.desc.subagent.maxParallelChunkQue: Max parallel chunk queries per subagent wave (1-16).
config.desc.subagent.stableSystemPrompt: Reuse one frozen system prompt for all subagents in a run.
config.desc.modelLoad.autoLoad: Load the model into the backend automatically on start.
config.desc.modelLoad.flashAttention: Enable flash-attention kernels when loading the model.
config.desc.modelLoad.offloadKvCacheToGp: Keep the KV cache in GPU memory when loading the model.
config.desc.modelLoad.evalBatchSize: Prompt-eval batch size at load time (1-4096).
config.desc.webSearch.enabled: Allow the agent to search the web.
config.desc.errorWebSearch.enabled: Search the web automatically when an error looks searchable.
config.desc.errorWebSearch.threshold: How many matching errors trigger a search (1-20).
config.desc.errorWebSearch.maxResults: Max search results attached per error lookup (1-20).
config.desc.errorWebSearch.maxQueryChars: Max chars of the error text sent per query (50-2000).
config.desc.errorWebSearch.maxSearchesPe: Max automatic error searches per session (0-20).
config.desc.errorWebSearch.requestTimeou: Timeout per automatic error-search request, in ms (1000-120000).
config.desc.browser.enabled: Allow the agent to drive a browser.
config.desc.browser.headless: Run the browser without a visible window.
config.desc.browser.maxContentChars: Max chars of page content kept per snapshot (100-50000).
config.desc.browser.maxConsoleEntries: Max browser console entries collected per snapshot (1-200).
config.desc.browser.navigationTimeout: Timeout per page navigation, in ms (1000-120000).
config.desc.security.maxRecursionDepth: Max nested tool-call depth before refusal (0-20).
config.desc.security.maxFileOperations: Max file operations per turn before refusal (0-10000).
config.desc.security.rateLimits.maxReque: LLM request rate cap per minute (1-1000).
config.desc.tools.defaultTags: Tool groups always loaded without on-demand gating.
config.desc.security.bash.enabled: Master switch for bash tool validation.
config.desc.security.bash.blockDangerous: Reject risky shell flags like --force in the bash tool.
config.desc.security.network.enabled: Master switch for outbound network checks (SSRF guard).
config.desc.security.bash.blacklist: Commands always blocked in the bash tool (list).
config.desc.security.bash.whitelist: Commands always allowed in the bash tool (list).
config.desc.security.paths.denied: Paths always off-limits for file tools (list).
config.desc.security.paths.allowed: Extra paths allowed outside the workspace (list).
config.desc.security.network.deniedDomai: Domains the agent may never contact (list).
config.desc.security.network.allowedDoma: Domains the agent may contact (list; empty means any).
config.desc.security.network.requestTime: Timeout per outbound tool request, in ms (1000-120000).
config.desc.security.network.maxResponse: Max bytes kept per outbound response (1024-1000000).
config.desc.security.contentScan.dangero: Regular expressions searched in file contents before writing.
config.desc.security.auditNotifier.enabl: Send security-audit events to a file or webhook.
config.desc.security.auditNotifier.fileP: File the audit events are appended to.
config.desc.security.auditNotifier.webho: Webhook the audit events are posted to.
Timeout per webhook post, in ms (1000-60000).
config.desc.security.auditNotifier.event: Which audit event types notify; none selected means all.
config.desc.security.sessionEncryption.e: Encrypt the saved chat history on disk.
Encrypt the saved session.jsonl log on disk.
config.desc.modelCapabilities: Manual vision/tools overrides per model id.
config.desc.experts: Expert roster for the MoE orchestrator.
config.desc.orchestrator.model: Model that plans and verifies MoE subtasks (empty = active model).
config.desc.orchestrator.provider: Provider for the planner model (empty = active provider).
config.desc.orchestrator.contextWindow: Context window for the planner model (default 32768).
config.desc.service.port: Port the Agent Service API listens on (mma serve).
config.desc.service.host: Bind address; non-loopback requires a token.
config.desc.service.token: Required Authorization: Bearer token for control plane → runtime.
config.desc.service.resultRetentionDays: How long terminal task results are kept in memory.
config.desc.service.syncWaitMs: Upper bound for wait:true before returning 202.
config.desc.service.maxQueueLength: FIFO queue cap per session; overflow returns queue-full.
config.desc.service.callbackTimeoutMs: Timeout for delivering a webhook callback.
config.desc.service.webhookSecret: Secret used to sign webhook callbacks (HMAC-SHA256).
